USWDS flex tokens provide simple options for setting the flex width of an item.

## Flex tokens

| Token | Example | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `1` |  | 1 0 0 |
| `2` |  | 2 0 0 |
| `3` |  | 3 0 0 |
| `4` |  | 4 0 0 |
| `5` |  | 5 0 0 |
| `6` |  | 6 0 0 |
| `7` |  | 7 0 0 |
| `8` |  | 8 0 0 |
| `9` |  | 9 0 0 |
| `10` |  | 10 0 0 |
| `11` |  | 11 0 0 |
| `12` |  | 12 0 0 |
| `'auto'` |  | auto |
| `'fill'` |  | 1 0 0 |

## Using flex tokens

Your context and coding style determine how you access USWDS flex tokens in code.

| Context | Usage | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| function | flex( [flex](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/flex/)) | flex: flex(`'fill'`) |
| mixin | u-flex( [flex](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/flex/)) | @include u-flex(`'fill'`) |
| setting | [flex](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/flex/) | $theme-nav-column-flex: `4` |
| utility | .flex- [flex](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/flex/) | .flex-`fill` |
